rows: The OpenData API exposes current product metadata and download links; OpenData calls do not require an API key.
Ambient credentials must not be forwarded to an unpinned endpoint.
The products operation returns the currently available OpenData product list as application/json.
A product name match alone does not bind release date, licence or exact product identity.
Download discovery supports fileName, format, subformat and area filters and can redirect to a file.
The client must validate the final HTTPS object identity and response metadata.
The API is intended for automated discovery and retrieval of current OS datasets.
Automation still requires bounded responses, provenance and generation receipts.
OS Terrain 50 is updated annually in July and supplied as grid and contour data.
A current catalogue label does not prove the exact downloaded archive bytes.
Grid and contour products are supplied as 10 km by 10 km tiles identified by the southwest National Grid reference.
Archive contents must be bound to required areas and tile identities.
ASCII grid rows contain 200 pixels, pixels are 50 m by 50 m, and values represent pixel centres.
The implementation must validate headers, dimensions, origin, cell size and tile bounds.
The product is supplied annually each July as ASCII grid and GML among its formats.
Supply cadence and format metadata must be recorded with exact archive hashes.
Tile metadata describes product identification, status and revision context.
The current pipeline does not bind tile metadata to sampled grid bytes.
Session trust_env controls proxy configuration, default authentication and related environment behaviour.
Official-source sessions should explicitly disable or receipt ambient environment trust.
Requests uses standard proxy environment variables unless proxy behaviour is overridden.
Loopback or official-host identity cannot be inferred from the requested URL alone.
Requests may obtain credentials from netrc and trust_env=False disables this behaviour.
Credential policy must be explicit before following redirects or accepting custom endpoints.
ZipInfo exposes file_size, compress_size and flag_bits, and ZipFile.testzip can test members.
Applications must add count, ratio, encryption, method and platform-name limits.
Path resolution normalizes paths and can resolve symbolic links.
Windows final-handle and reparse containment may require platform-specific checks.
subprocess timeout handling raises TimeoutExpired and cleanup is an explicit caller responsibility.
A wrapper without a timeout can remain pending indefinitely.
Temporary-file helpers create unique files securely.
Atomic publication also requires same-volume placement and replacement policy.
os.replace can atomically replace a destination when the operating-system contract permits.
Durability and multi-file generation identity remain separate requirements.
hashlib computes SHA-256 over exact bytes.
A post-read digest does not prove that the previously sampled bytes were unchanged.
all_touched includes every pixel touched by a geometry, while the default uses centres or Bresenham selection.
Exact expected cell identity and count must be specified for deterministic crosschecks.
Rasterio distinguishes GDAL valid-data masks from NumPy masked-array semantics and documents mask precedence.
Nodata values, dataset masks and sidecars must be bound to the sampled dataset.
Raster georeferencing combines CRS definition with the transform mapping pixels to coordinates.
EPSG alone does not prove expected tile bounds, origin, resolution or rotation.
Dataset indexes, dtypes and nodata values are available from opened raster datasets.
The crosschecker must require the expected band and datatype schema.
AAIGrid uses an ASCII grid plus an optional PRJ file and preserves NODATA when available.
A file extension alone does not prove valid AAIGrid content or the correct sidecar pair.
Windows reserves device names and uses colon syntax for alternate data streams.
Archive extraction must reject unsafe or case-colliding platform names.
